Name: Breads Anime Portraits
Author: BlandBreads
Description:
[b][center][color=#ffff00][size=5]This is my Hi-Res Portrait mod for the vanilla NPC's. (Some are refrenced from Ohodavi and SHIE portrait mods)
You'll need the [color=#cc0000][color=#ff0000][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url][/color][color=#ff0000]﻿[/color][/color] Mod to make this mod works.
[color=#d5a6bd][b][size=5]~[/size][/b]SVE Characters included (up to Claire)!~[/color][/size][/color][/center][color=#3c78d8][size=4][u]
[/u][color=#ff7700]Sorry for the sudden notice,but apparently,I'm discontinuing this mod updates.[color=#3c78d8] [color=#ff7700]I'm not quite comfortable to continue with the style of my drawing currently so i'm going to try new styles and who knows,maybe I'll continue or make another new portrait mods.[/color][/color][/color][/size][/color][/b][color=#3c78d8][size=4][b]
[u]
Installation (always make a back-up)[/u] :[/b][/size][/color]

1. Unpack the zip files
2. Drop the BREADS folder into the "Portraiture" MOD folder.
3. Done!
